note: Read each source file once per build in the passes that run before the bundler. The import graph, the class-slot reservation and the prewarm read the same files, and a Next production build runs them once per compiler (server, edge, client): they now share a stamp-checked source cache (`withSourceCache` / `readSource` in plugin-utils), which Next passes to the webpack plugin of each compiler. Watch and dev builds keep reading the disk on every compilation. Output is unchanged.
